name: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Kew Gardens sprawls across 132 hectares in southwest London, where glasshouses and landscaped grounds have grown since 1759. Visitors wander among plants from around the world, drawn from a collection of some 27,000 kinds. Behind the scenes, a herbarium of over 8.5 million preserved specimens makes Kew one of the planet's leading centres for studying plants and fungi.
